title: Chapter 1329 - 12: Shock
content:
Chapter 1329 - 12: Shock

Chapter 1329: Chapter 12: Shock

The Demon God did not care about what Lin Yuan said, but instinctively noticed the unusual change in Lin Yuan’s strength from before and after.

Thousands of years ago, it had fought fiercely with Lin Yuan.

At that time, facing its attack, even if it wasn’t difficult to resist, it certainly wasn’t easy.

But now?

An attack of such seriousness was so easily blocked by him?

The Demon God didn’t have a mind or will, but it had instincts and realized something was wrong.

"How is this possible?"

"That giant tail of the Demon God, although it was just pure strength, was so easily blocked..."

Outside the source world, thirteen Eternal Lords were also watching closely, with a surge of disbelief in their hearts.

They acknowledged Lin Yuan’s strength, but the defensive power displayed now was terrifying. Not many Eternal Lords had such defense; only those Eternal Lords proficient in defense could achieve this.

"Is this the confidence of Galaxy, who has cultivated some defensive inheritance secret technique, confident enough to withstand the Demon God’s attack?"

The Master of Black Space pondered, speculating out loud.

Seeing Lin Yuan easily blocking the Demon God’s serious attack was almost equivalent to securing a position of innate invincibility.

With such defense, even if the Demon God were to stand and attack, it would likely be difficult to break through. Even if it broke through, so what?

Breaking Lin Yuan’s defense would definitely reduce the power of the move, naturally lowering the threat.

And judging from the previous confrontations, Lin Yuan’s recovery ability was particularly terrifying. At that time, the Demon God’s blow caused Lin Yuan considerable injury, but he recovered in an instant.

A terrifying recovery ability.

Plus, with such a formidable defense now,

it’s as if the Demon God simply cannot do anything about Lin Yuan.

"So that’s how it is."

The Master of Wushan suddenly realized and praised in his heart: "Not an Eternal Lord, but with defense to this extent, how exactly did Galaxy cultivate?"

"Someone with a destined future is certainly different from us."

The Master of Infinite smiled and said.

...

"Now it’s my turn."

Lin Yuan looked at the Demon God; he intentionally took a hit from the Demon God to test whether his defense could be broken by the opponent.

As of now, this question seems unnecessary. Even if the Demon God put all its effort, it would only barely break Lin Yuan’s current defense.

He would instantly be restored by the ’Rebirth from a Drop of Blood’ divine skill.

Rustle.

Infinite chaos taiji power gathered, coalescing into a black and white yin-yang iron rod in front of Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan held the black and white yin-yang iron rod and heavily smashed it towards the Demon God.

If it were a normal duel, Lin Yuan would definitely suppress the Demon God with the Chaotic Tai Chi Diagram and then try to weaken the Demon God as much as possible.

But now Lin Yuan just wanted to see his true strength, his current level, and how he compared to other time beings.

So, he naturally chose the most direct approach.

If the Chaos Tai Chi Sword represents the ultimate killing power, cutting through everything in its path,

then the Chaos Taiji Stick is a total overwhelming force, differing in its range of attack.

After one strike, the entire fallen area would completely collapse.

"Boom——"

The infinite might of a single strike smashed onto the Demon God’s body. Even though the Demon God struggled to defend, it still felt its most microscopic particles being crushed. The invisible taiji power swept through, clashing against the infinite demonic qi inside the Demon God, constantly dissolving each other, causing even the Demon God’s form to become unstable.

Whoosh!

The Demon God stepped back several steps, suddenly taking a deep breath.

Instantly, the large amounts of demonic qi permeating the source world were swallowed by the Demon God in one gulp. With this demonic qi’s support, the Demon God’s body quickly stabilized, expelling the invading chaotic taiji power.

"Hmm?" Lin Yuan observed the Demon God’s act of inhaling and exhaling demonic qi.

In fact, neither the current Demon God nor the previous Demon God was its strongest form.

The Demon God’s strongest form is when it recollects all the demonic qi permeating the entire source world, gathering it into one; that is the Demon God’s peak moment.

"I wonder what the Demon God’s strongest form’s strength would be." Lin Yuan wondered to himself. As the Black Demon form of the Time Lord, even without mind or will, only capable of using clumsy moves, it should be stronger than ordinary time beings.

The Lord of Heaven Light’s bright form directly held back the thirteen Eternal Lords.

Even if the Black Demon form is somewhat weaker, it can’t be that weak.

"Continue." Lin Yuan continued swinging the Chaos Taiji Stick, smashing it towards the Demon God.

Each smash seemed simple, yet it utilized an extremely high degree of spacetime dao. Under one smash, spacetime was frozen, making it impossible for the Demon God to dodge, only to passively endure.

Bang!

Bang!

Bang!!!

Each of Lin Yuan’s smashes made the Demon God step back several steps. Even with the infinite demonic qi spreading across the entire source world, the Demon God still struggled, each smash making the demonic form dim further.

"Roar!!!"

The Demon God roared to the heavens, the surrounding demonic qi suddenly exploded, terrifying energy waves sweeping in all directions, likewise covering Lin Yuan.

"Hmm? Another new move?"

Lin Yuan’s eyes slightly brightened; he had never seen this move before. Clearly, it was the Demon God’s hidden tactic.

But unfortunately.

Lin Yuan, who had reached the third level of the Chaotic Taiji Dao, cultivated the blessing of the endless Constant Sand Particle World within his body. The Chaos Taiji Stick he condensed wielded overwhelming might that defied explanation, and the erupting Demonic Qi could not shake that Black and White Yin Yang Iron Rod.

The Chaos Taiji Stick swung again, smashing fiercely onto the Demon God’s body.

"Roar!!"

The Demon God continued its fierce resistance, employing many never-before-seen techniques, some of which could be considered innate abilities of the Black Demon.

However.

In the face of Lin Yuan’s repeated strikes, the Demon God’s every attempt to resist was futile. At most, it could only delay its retreat, ultimately being swept away by the Chaos Taiji Stick.

"Roar roar roar!!"

The Demon God retreated continuously, the Chaos Taiji Stick striking down madly, causing its demon body to collapse and flesh to separate. Yet, the Demon God absorbed large amounts of Demonic Qi, speeding its recovery.

...

In a hidden world.

Several Sect Masters and many high-level elders stared with eyes wide open.

Their insight was naturally far inferior to the Eternal Lords, so when the Demon God initially clashed with Lin Yuan, they saw nothing unusual, thinking the fight was evenly matched.

The initial encounter between Lin Yuan and the Demon God seemed no different.

But as time passed, with Lin Yuan wielding the Chaos Taiji Stick, the Demon God could only retreat, all its struggles swept aside by Lin Yuan’s strikes.

Even fools could see the battle’s tide at this point.

Lin Yuan was overwhelming the Demon God, and it was an undisputed suppression, making it difficult for the Demon God to even retaliate.

"How is Lord Galaxy so powerful?"

"For thousands of years, no worldly phenomena indicating an Eternal Lord’s breakthrough have appeared, and Lord Galaxy has not stepped into becoming an Eternal Lord."

"Not an Eternal Lord, yet overpowering the Demon God?"

....

Several Sect Masters and many sect leaders almost believed they were witnessing an illusion.

If not for the undeniable fluctuations of Demonic Qi and the images detected by the Eternal Treasure, they would not dare to believe this scene before their eyes.

Clearly, the Demon God couldn’t contend with Lord Galaxy, struggling to withstand his attacks. Without repeatedly absorbing large amounts of Demonic Qi for support, it likely would have failed long ago.

But how was this possible?

Wasn’t the Demon God’s strength supposed to rival that of the Eternal Lords?

...

Outside the source world, all the observing Eternal Lords fell silent.

At first, they thought Lin Yuan’s breakthrough was in terms of defense, hence his bold challenge against the Demon God.

But now?

Was this merely a breakthrough in defense?

This suppression of the Demon God, leaving it with no ability to fight back, was a comprehensive breakthrough, not just in defense.

The thirteen Eternal Lords saw very clearly that every strike from Lin Yuan encompassed profound rules and principles, and the rod formed by the Black and White Yin Yang Qi was a manifestation of some extremely powerful Dao.

"Terrifying, how could Galaxy’s power increase so much? If I were in the Demon God’s position, I wouldn’t fare much better, lacking any ability to resist."

"Same here."

"Every strike from Galaxy suppresses the myriad ways of spacetime, how to resist? With what means?"

"With Galaxy’s current power, he could end the demon disaster now; the Demon God simply cannot withstand."

The Eternal Lords conversed, their eyes filled with amazement.

Among the thirteen Eternal Lords, fewer than six were confident they could contend with Lin Yuan in his current state.

Still having six Eternal Lords who could rival Lin Yuan doesn’t sound too bad, and not too disgraceful.

But note.

Galaxy is not an Eternal Lord.

He is, essentially, still a being of the Free Three Realms.

A life form below the Eternal Lord, not only exerting the strength of an Eternal Lord but also suppressing ordinary Eternal Lords.

This... this...

The Eternal Lords didn’t know how to describe Lin Yuan.

They had often spoken with the Lord of Heaven Light and learned during chats with this Time Lord that there were many unbelievable beings within the mysterious dimensional gaps.

However, compared to the current Lin Yuan, even the most incredible beings seemed dim and lackluster.

"Galaxy..."

The Master of Infinite looked at the scene of Lin Yuan striking the Demon God with a complex expression.

If he faced the Demon God, he could do the same, but how many long years had he trained? And still, from the standpoint of an Eternal Lord.

...

Within the source world.

Under Lin Yuan’s repeated fierce strikes, the Demon God’s demonic body suddenly exploded, transforming into endless Demonic Qi, re-assimilating into the world.

"Retreated?" Lin Yuan, holding the Chaos Taiji Stick, pondered slightly.

Until the end, the Demon God had never shown its strongest form, nor absorbed all the Demonic Qi permeating the world to battle him.

Instead, it voluntarily dissipated its demon body, returning to the endless Demonic Qi, avoiding further contact with Lin Yuan.

"Let it be."

Lin Yuan shook his head, not attempting to pursue the Demon God.

Through this battle with the Demon God, he also understood the true extent of his own strength.
